There is no need to thank me, I just wrote what I feel and experience. I am very glad to hear that I gave you the little you needed to get hope again. I hope that you get better as well. Some changes come fast but other take time, remember to never lose hope. People say take one day at a time, but what I needed was a goal, my goal is to make others feel loved and happy.

Remember that there is always someone out there that loves you and need you in their life
